points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, establishing reproducible pipelines for document-level QA workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for automated systems.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable model performance monitoring.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster production inference.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining robust operation.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust CI/CD pipelines for ML model deployment.
